verdict.rationale: Deployment control is a fair question for an auth and user-management product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of Clerk offering self-managed deployment, a private or dedicated instance, or storage of user data in the customer's own database. "Deploy to your own domain" is a custom-domain feature, and "production instances" refers to Clerk-hosted environments, so neither counts as control over where the auth system or its data runs.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can control where the auth system and its user data run — self-managed deployment, private instance, or my own database
